name: How long does a typical bathroom vanity and cabinet upgrade project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical bathroom vanity and cabinet upgrade project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a bathroom vanity and cabinet upgrade project varies based on the scope of work. A simple replacement of a vanity might take a few days, while a more extensive project involving custom cabinetry, plumbing adjustments, and countertop installation could extend to one to two weeks. Factors like material availability and any unexpected structural issues can also influence the timeline. We provide a detailed project schedule before starting work.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical upgrade can take anywhere from a few days for simple replacements to one to two weeks for more extensive projects.
